title: The Mystery of the Rainbow Bridge
synopsis: Starting where Episode 12 ended, Tock waves goodbye ('Come back by purple o'clock!') and the friends jump into the Master Clock's image of a rainbow bridge. They land on a floating island above the clouds, where a giant seven-band Rainbow Bridge links drifting islands, but its colours are fading: red turns pale, blue goes grey, yellow flickers, and little clouds pop away. The bridge turns see-through under Bobo's feet, Kiko fakes a fall through it and bounces back on a cloud ('Just kidding!'), Draco's dragon magic makes one tiny puff, and Bobo asks for a banana safety rail. Behind a colourful cloud they meet Pico, a tiny rainbow chameleon and guardian of the bridge, who changes colour whenever startled; Kiko's 'Boo!' sends Pico through every colour ('Were you blue, green, purple, or a walking rainbow?' 'Um... even I forgot!'). On the islands of missing colours they collect colour orbs: Bobo mistakes the orange one for breakfast, Kiko swaps it for a stone (clonk), and Draco flies into a colourful cloud ('I meant to do that!' 'Of course you did!'). At the Rainbow Gate each colour is a quality (courage, friendship, happiness, kindness, trust, imagination, hope); Lumi puts them in rainbow order, Bobo plugs the orange gap with a banana ('It should be. It's banana!'), and Kiko finally hands back the real orange orb. In the chamber at the bridge's crown the Rainbow Heart has almost faded and Pico feels like a bad guardian; Lumi encourages Pico, Kiko places the orbs, Draco lights the pedestal with a small careful flame, Bobo trips into a burst of rainbow energy, and Pico shines: the heart is restored, and Bobo is left in seven colours ('I look like a banana that went on vacation!'). The colour spreads across the whole bridge, the islands reconnect and rainbow light falls pour down; Pico dodges Kiko's next prank by hiding in a rainbow flower, and Kiko takes the first bite of Bobo's rainbow banana.
ending: The Rainbow Heart projects a music box in an enchanted castle. 'Listen! I think our next adventure has a secret melody!' Next: The Mystery of the Magical Music Box.
newCharacters: Pico, a tiny rainbow chameleon and guardian of the Rainbow Bridge: mint-green soft scales, huge turquoise eyes in round chameleon turrets, a little crest, a curled tail, tiny feet and a glowing rainbow mark on the forehead; playful and curious, startles easily and changes colour every time, tries to look brave (Pico in src/ep13/props.tsx, voice bf_lily pitched 1.36)
